title: Build Manager Manifest v1
description: Declares the desired state of a Kodi installation. See docs/MANIFEST.md for the full reference.

schema_version.description: Manifest format version. Must be 1 for this schema. Allows the parser to reject or upgrade manifests written for a different format.

engine_min_version.description: Minimum Build Manager engine (add-on) version required to process this manifest. Absent means no minimum constraint is declared.

build.description: Build identity and versioning. The build version is independent of the Build Manager engine version.

id.description: Stable machine-readable identifier. Set once and never changed. Used for version tracking and repair detection.

version.description: Semantic version of this build definition. Increment when the desired state changes. Independent of the Build Manager add-on version.

name.description: Human-readable display name shown in the Build Manager UI.

description.description: Optional human-readable description of this build.

repositories.description: Kodi repositories that must be installed before add-on resolution. Processed in order.

addons.description: Base set of add-ons and their desired state. Applies to all profiles unless overridden by a platform or device profile.

skin.description: Desired active skin. Absent means Build Manager does not manage skin selection for this build.

config.description: Common managed-configuration declarations. Lists which packages, setting keys, and files this build owns. Contains no setting values.

platform_profiles.description: Platform-specific overrides. Keys are stable platform identifiers (e.g. 'tvos', 'android', 'macos'). Each value extends the base build.

device_profiles.description: Device-specific overrides. Keys are stable device identifiers (e.g. 'bonus-room', 'shield'). Each device profile must declare which platform profile it extends.

optional.description: Named optional component groups. Platform and device profiles may include them by ID. Groups are applied after platform and device layers.

private_overlay.description: Reference to an optional private configuration overlay. Describes where to find it; contains no secrets or credential values.

restart_policy.description: Declares which restart types Build Manager may perform during provisioning.

addon_state.description: 'enabled': must be installed and enabled. 'disabled': must be installed but disabled. Add-on removal is not supported by the public Kodi API; omit an add-on to leave it unmanaged. An add-on omitted from a profile layer inherits its state from the parent layer — omission is NOT equivalent to 'disabled'.

addon_entry.description: An add-on and its required state in this layer.

addon_id.description: Kodi add-on identifier exactly as Kodi knows it.

note.description: Human-readable note for maintainers. Not processed by the engine.

addon_override.description: Overrides the state of an add-on inherited from a parent layer. If the addon_id does not appear in the parent, it is added to the resolved set.

repository.description: A Kodi repository that must be installed before add-on resolution. Repositories are not subject to profile layering; the base list applies globally.

addon_id.description: Kodi repository add-on identifier. Must start with 'repository.'.

bootstrap_url.description: URL to the repository ZIP used for initial bootstrap when the repository is not yet installed. Not used if the repository is already present.

required.description: If true (default), provisioning must not continue if this repository cannot be installed.

skin_entry.description: The desired active skin and optional configuration packages to apply after activation.

addon_id.description: Kodi skin add-on identifier. Must start with 'skin.'.

config_packages.description: Named configuration packages to apply after skin activation. Package names correspond to entries in config.packages.

config_declarations.description: Declares which configuration is owned by this build layer. Contains no setting values. Values are stored in separate configuration packages (not in the manifest).

packages.description: Named configuration packages included in this layer. Package names are opaque to the schema; the engine resolves them to actual files.

managed_settings.description: Declares which setting keys within specific add-ons are owned by this build. The engine will overwrite these keys; it will not touch keys not listed here.

managed_files.description: Relative Kodi userdata paths that Build Manager owns and may overwrite. Paths are relative to the Kodi userdata directory. Path traversal sequences are forbidden.

managed_setting_scope.description: Declares that Build Manager owns specific setting keys for one explicit add-on or skin target namespace. Omitted target preserves normal add-on-setting behavior.

target.description: Runtime target namespace. 'addon' is the backward-compatible default; 'skin' targets the currently active Kodi skin via its dedicated skin-setting API.

keys.description: Setting key names owned by this build for the given add-on.

profile_layer.description: A platform profile. Layered on top of the base build. All fields are optional; absent fields mean 'inherit from base'.

label.description: Human-readable platform name for display in the UI.

addons.description: Add-on state overrides for this platform. Only add-ons listed here are affected; all others inherit from the base. Merge rule: same addon_id overrides state; new addon_id is appended to the resolved set.

config.description: Configuration declarations merged on top of the base. Package lists union; managed_settings keys union per add-on.

skin.description: Platform-specific skin override. Absent means inherit the base skin.

include_optional.description: Optional group IDs (from the top-level 'optional' list) to activate for this platform.

device_profile.description: A device profile. Must extend exactly one platform profile. Represents a single physical device or role.

label.description: Human-readable device name shown in the profile selection UI.

extends.description: Required. Platform profile ID this device inherits from. Must match a key in platform_profiles. Semantic validation that the referenced ID exists is performed by the parser (BM-003), not the schema.

addons.description: Add-on state overrides for this device. Applied after the platform layer. Merge rule: same as platform layer — same addon_id overrides, new addon_id appended.

config.description: Device-specific configuration declarations merged on top of the platform layer.

skin.description: Device-specific skin override. Absent means inherit from the platform layer (or base).

include_optional.description: Optional group IDs to activate for this device, in addition to any activated at the platform layer.

optional_group.description: A named set of optional components. Activated by platform or device profiles via include_optional. Applied after device profile resolution.

id.description: Stable identifier used in include_optional lists.

addons.description: Add-ons in this optional group. Applied after device profile layer. Merge rule: same as profile layers.

config.description: Configuration declarations contributed by this optional group.

private_overlay_ref.description: A reference to a private configuration overlay. The public manifest describes where to find the overlay; the overlay itself is never committed to the public repository.

type.description: 'local_file': the overlay is a JSON file at a local filesystem path on the target device.

path_hint.description: Suggested local path. Build Manager may use this as a default and prompt the user if the file is absent. Must not contain secrets.

description.description: Human-readable description of what the private overlay contains.

restart_policy.description: Governs which restart actions Build Manager may take during provisioning. Both default to true.

allow_skin_reload.description: Permit a skin reload (lighter than a full restart). Required for some skin configuration changes.

allow_kodi_restart.description: Permit a full Kodi restart. Required after skin changes and some add-on installations.
